Definition: from G4253 and G1096; to be already, i.e. have previously transpired:--be past.
BiblicalUsage: Proginomai means to be already, to have previously transpired, to be past. Paul uses it once: God set forth Christ to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that sins that are past are still sins, and the cross reaches backwards as well as forwards.
